sections.title: Angular Training Courses Ireland
sections.subtitle: Practical, instructor-led training in-person at our Dublin, Cork and Limerick offices, at your premises nationwide or live online. Learn to build fast, well-structured web applications with Angular and TypeScript, from your first component to advanced patterns and testing.

sections.title: About our Angular courses
content: Angular is a platform and framework for building single-page applications with HTML and TypeScript. It is a large framework, and getting started can feel daunting: you need to learn TypeScript as well as components, services, dependency injection, routing and reactive forms before a project comes together.

Our instructor-led courses give developers who have worked on web applications a practical, hands-on start with Angular. Follow-on courses cover the advanced features and techniques used on real projects, along with full-stack TypeScript development. We also teach AngularJS, the original 1.x framework, for teams maintaining older applications.

quotes.text: Our participants noted that there were lots of coding examples used and the trainer explained examples well and paused where participants had issues. We really got through a lot in a week. We will definitely be booking further courses for our graduate programmes.
quotes.name: Learning & Development Manager

sections.title: Find the right Angular course for you
